expansion_rules.action: Replace the first use with the expansion followed by the abbreviation in parentheses. Keep the later uses.
expansion_rules.example_after: An intensive care unit (ICU) nurse checked the magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) results. The ICU team reviewed the MRI.
expansion_rules.example_before: An ICU nurse checked the MRI results. The ICU team reviewed the MRI.
expansion_rules.exceptions: Rule N and Do not abbreviate entries. Rule G entries when audience is professional. Text in quotations, URLs, names.
expansion_rules.name: First use without a definition
expansion_rules.trigger: An abbreviation appears and is never defined, and it is used at least twice (minUses).

expansion_rules.action: Replace the repeated full term with the abbreviation.
expansion_rules.behaviour_raw: Auto-fix when the definition is in the same scope
expansion_rules.example_after: The patient was admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) after surgery. The ICU staff reviewed the chart.
expansion_rules.example_before: The patient was admitted to the intensive care unit after surgery. The intensive care unit staff reviewed the chart.
expansion_rules.exceptions: Quotations. A new scope (a new chapter or the body after an abstract) starts again at AB01.
expansion_rules.name: Expansion repeated after the abbreviation is defined
expansion_rules.trigger: The full term appears again after the abbreviation was introduced.

expansion_rules.action: Move the definition to the first use. Replace the later definition with the abbreviation.
expansion_rules.example_after: The intensive care unit (ICU) was full. Patients in the ICU were stable.
expansion_rules.example_before: The ICU was full. Patients in the intensive care unit (ICU) were stable.
expansion_rules.name: Abbreviation used before it is defined
expansion_rules.trigger: The abbreviation appears first without a definition and a definition appears later.

expansion_rules.action: Keep the first. Replace each later definition with the abbreviation.
expansion_rules.example_after: Intensive care unit (ICU) beds were full. The ICU opened more beds.
expansion_rules.example_before: Intensive care unit (ICU) beds were full. The intensive care unit (ICU) opened more beds.
expansion_rules.name: Definition repeated
expansion_rules.trigger: The full term with the abbreviation in parentheses appears more than once in the same scope.

expansion_rules.action: Spell the term out and drop the abbreviation and its parentheses.
expansion_rules.example_after: The patient was transferred to the postanesthesia care unit.
expansion_rules.example_before: The patient was transferred to the PACU.
expansion_rules.exceptions: Abbreviations that are listed as No expansion needed.
expansion_rules.name: Single use
expansion_rules.trigger: An abbreviation or a definition is used only once in the scope.

expansion_rules.action: Suggest the preferred form from Abbreviation_List and apply it throughout.
expansion_rules.example_after: (not run: needs a synonym table, see section 14 of the README)
expansion_rules.example_before: The ECG and the EKG were reviewed.
expansion_rules.name: Inconsistent abbreviations for one term
expansion_rules.trigger: Two abbreviations (for example ECG and EKG) or a mix of the abbreviation and the full term is used for the same thing.

expansion_rules.action: Use Context_Rules to pick the meaning. Ask the author when the cues do not decide. If both are needed, spell one out.
expansion_rules.example_before: PE: lungs clear. Heparin for PE after a DVT.
expansion_rules.name: One abbreviation with two meanings in a document
expansion_rules.trigger: The same abbreviation stands for different terms in the same scope.

expansion_rules.action: Offer the spelled-out replacement from Do_Not_Use.
expansion_rules.behaviour_raw: Flag and suggest. Never auto-fix a dose
expansion_rules.exceptions: Use only inside medication orders and doses, not statistics.
expansion_rules.name: Do-not-use abbreviation

expansion_rules.exceptions: Possessives such as the ICU's staff are not flagged because a noun follows.
expansion_rules.name: Apostrophe in a plural abbreviation
expansion_rules.trigger: An abbreviation followed by 's and a plural verb.

expansion_rules.action: Use the Article column for abbreviations and the sound rule for expansions.
expansion_rules.behaviour_raw: Auto-fix when the abbreviation or expansion is changed
expansion_rules.example_after: She had a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan. An MRI was repeated.
expansion_rules.example_before: She had a magnetic resonance imaging scan. A magnetic resonance imaging was repeated.
expansion_rules.name: Article agreement
expansion_rules.trigger: a or an before an abbreviation or an expansion that does not match its sound.

expansion_rules.action: Spell it out. Keep only universally known ones (for example DNA, HIV).
expansion_rules.example_after: Outcomes after coronary artery bypass graft in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
expansion_rules.name: Abbreviation in a title or heading
expansion_rules.trigger: An abbreviation in a title, subtitle or heading.

expansion_rules.action: Define it again at its first use in the body.
expansion_rules.name: Abstract and body are separate scopes
expansion_rules.trigger: An abbreviation defined in the abstract is used in the body with no definition.

expansion_rules.exceptions: Latin abbreviations such as e.g. and i.e. and a.m. and p.m., and the earlier Springer rules.
expansion_rules.name: Periods in an initialism

expansion_rules.action: Use lowercase unless the term is a proper noun or an organization name.
expansion_rules.name: Case of the expansion
expansion_rules.trigger: A common term written with capitals (Intensive Care Unit).

expansion_rules.action: Add the definition in the table note or figure legend. Do not rely on the body.
expansion_rules.example_after: Table note: BMI, body mass index.
expansion_rules.name: Tables and figures
expansion_rules.trigger: An abbreviation used in a table or figure with no note.

expansion_rules.action: Optionally define again at first use in each chapter or section (setting scopeReset).
expansion_rules.name: Scope reset

expansion_rules.action: Leave as written. Do not add a definition.
expansion_rules.name: Never expand
expansion_rules.trigger: Unit symbols, chemical symbols, credentials and universally known abbreviations (rule N).
